newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp of America names CFO.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp of America names CFO.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings said Friday it had named Wesley Elingburg executive vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer.
Elingburg, who has been senior vice president of finance at the company since it was formed in April 1995, succeeds Haywood Cochrane, who resigned to pursue other opportunities.
Laboratory Corp of America operates primary testing facilities, performing diagnostic tests for physicians, managed care organizations, hospitals, and other facilities.
